definitions.gloss: snow-covered landscape; world blanketed in snow
definitions.explanation: A poetic expression for a landscape covered entirely in white snow, evoking the image of a world turned silver.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銀世界|ぎんせかい}だった。
examples.english: When I woke up in the morning, the whole landscape was covered in snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いて→降り続く：21878_furitsuzuku⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銀世界|ぎんせかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The snow kept falling and the town turned into a silver world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧{銀世界|ぎんせかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大喜|おおよろこ}び→大喜び：28880_ooyorokobi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children were overjoyed at the snowy landscape spreading outside the window.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and evocative expression used to describe the beauty of a snow-covered landscape. Often appears in weather reports, travel writing, and seasonal descriptions. The word carries a positive, aesthetic connotation, focusing on the beauty rather than the inconvenience of heavy snow.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銀世界|ぎんせかい} (a landscape entirely covered in snow)
- {銀世界|ぎんせかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (to turn into a snowy landscape)
- {銀世界|ぎんせかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ (a snowy landscape spreads out)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雪景色|ゆきげしき}→雪景色：14666_yukigeshiki⟧: snowy scenery — a more neutral, descriptive term
- {雪化粧|ゆきげしょう}: snow-covered (lit. "snow makeup") — emphasizes light dusting of snow
